brief:
The head of the Jerusalem Committee in the Palestinian Scholars Association (Lebanon), Sheikh Ali al-Yousef, said the death of prominent leaders including the official spokesman for the Qassam Brigades, Abu Obeida, represents a beacon guiding the nation toward triumph, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Yousef made the remarks on the anniversary of the commander's death.

The scholar emphasized that the martyrdom of such leaders signals divine favor and an imminent victory for the Palestinian cause. He described the fallen commanders as exemplars whose sacrifice illuminates the path forward for the broader Arab and Muslim nation during a period of ongoing conflict.
